text:
Items: a chocolate chip cookie (~40 g, ~190 kcal), a latte (~300 ml with milk, ~150 kcal), and a chicken salad sandwich on a roll with cheese, lettuce and tomato (~250 g, ~500 kcal).

After the meal, the cookie is gone, the sandwich is gone (only the wrapper is left), and the latte cup is mostly empty with a little residue. That means almost everything was eaten.

Totals: kcal about 190 + 500 + 140 = 830. Mass is about 40 + 250 + 250 (latte liquid consumed) = 540 g.

{"kcal": 830, "mass_g": 540}
